name: qqnt-export
description: Local-first QQ NT chat reader and exporter with a pure CLI interface

scripts.build: node scripts/setup-sqlcipher.js && node scripts/build-core.js && node scripts/build-sea.js
scripts.test: node scripts/setup-sqlcipher.js && cargo build --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && node --test test/*.test.js && cargo test --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: node --check bin/qqnt-export.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/runtime.js && cargo check --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml
